claims: The 2026 MLB regular season officially begins on Wednesday, March 25.
The 2026 MLB regular season begins with a standalone Opening Night game between the New York Yankees and San Francisco Giants.
The traditional Opening Day takes place on Thursday, March 26.
Opening Day features a full slate of 14 games for 28 teams.
Opening Night is March 25 with Yankees @ Giants.
Opening Day is March 26 with 22 teams in action.
Six teams begin their season on Friday, March 27.
All 30 MLB teams play on Saturday, March 28.
Pirates @ Mets at 1:15 p.m. ET on NBC/Peacock on Opening Day March 26.
Nationals @ Cubs at 2:20 p.m. ET on Opening Day March 26.
D-backs @ Dodgers at 8:30 p.m. ET on NBC/Peacock on Opening Day March 26.
Red Sox @ Reds at 4:10 p.m. ET on Opening Day March 26.
